Variants.Content: Entry The Golden Robes are the City Watch of King's Landing, responsible for the gates, streets, curfews, riots, prisoners, and the day-to-day order of the capital. They are not like the Kingsguard who are only loyal to the royal family, nor are they attached to the countryside like the vassal knights; the golden robes are salary, system and Commoners will rely on them to keep order in the marketplace and fear them when taxing, capturing, or suppressing. Who commands the Golden Robes affects their behavior, and the fact remains that King's Landing requires a force that knows its streets, gates, and people.
